title: No Xp Spawner
description: Disable XP from mob spawners and trial spawners.
body:
## ⚡ Disable XP from Mob Spawners

No XP Spawner disables experience (XP) gained from mobs spawned by spawners.

This helps prevent players from abusing mob farms for fast leveling,
while keeping normal gameplay intact.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🚫 Disable XP from mobs spawned by **normal spawners**
- 🧪 Supports **trial spawners (Minecraft 1.21+)**
- 🎁 Optional control over item drops
- ⚙️ Separate settings for each spawner type
- 🔄 Real-time config updates (no restart required)
- ⌨️ Reload command support

---

## 📦 Usage

Simply install the mod and configure it via:

config/noxpspawner/config.yml

Changes are applied instantly.

---

## ⌨️ Commands

- /nxs reload  
- /noxpspawner reload  

Reload the configuration without restarting the game or server.

---

## ⚠️ Notes

- 🎯 Only affects mobs spawned by spawners  
- 🌙 Does NOT affect natural spawns or spawn eggs  

---
